decisions.reason: The shop relaunch SEO service has had its own page for two years, fits the firm's chosen direction toward SEO consulting, and costs little to keep running, so commitment and sunk investment favor keeping it.

The SEO workshops were launched only in 2024 as part of the firm's visible shift toward SEO services, so weak early results can still be blamed on a start-up phase and management will want to justify the recent decision.
